question: What do the Skydio X10 and the DJI Matrice 30T do when the link is lost?

intake.reason: Question asks what happens on loss of control/link for DJI Matrice 30T; Skydio X10 is not in the collection, so only DJI Matrice 30T guidance is applicable here.

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance: reestablish the control link, or start emergency/contingency procedures and discontinue flight until the control link is inspected. Manuals: no usable evidence identified in the approved collection for the DJI Matrice 30T or Skydio X10. Incident reports (unverified): ASRS notes lost-link with RTH occurred twice, and the RTH was at a programmed altitude with no issue. Gap or conflict: FAA guidance expectations (reestablish/link or emergency procedures) conflict with unverified reports showing RTH at programmed altitude, and there is no model‑specific automatic lost-link behavior described for the DJI Matrice 30T; explicit conditions for automatic RTH and other factors remain unaddressed. There is also no inclusion of Skydio X10 in the approved collection.
